summary: MiMedx Group filed an 8-K disclosing that it and merger partner Sanara MedTech each received a Second Request for additional information and documentary materials from the FTC on October 15, 2026, in connection with the FTC's review of their pending merger. Under the announced merger agreement, MiMedx's wholly owned subsidiary Mustang Merger Sub will merge into Sanara, with Sanara surviving as a wholly owned MiMedx subsidiary. The Second Request extends the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance unless earlier terminated; no price, premium, or outside date was disclosed. Watch FTC timing and any divestiture demands.
